classification.vuln_type: assert-abort (invalid enum value mapped into internal session_type)

trigger.message: PFCP Session Establishment Request with PDN Type IE value = 0
trigger.field: PDN Type value = 0. Spec defines: 1=IPv4, 2=IPv6, 3=IPv4v6, 4=Non-IP, 5=Ethernet. Value 0 is spare/reserved. open5gs maps the wire byte directly into an internal `session_type` enum without semantic range check, then `upf_sess_set_ue_ip` asserts on the (zero) session_type. Classic PB1 'Invalid Value' (unsupported enum value).
trigger.precondition: PFCP association established with the UPF before sending the Session Establishment Request.
